notes.title: EXCHANGE HEALTH UPDATE V0.2.7
notes.content:
[h1] EXCHANGE HEALTH UPDATE V0.2.7	[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33637143/39f8e95e95fd766063c47474f21b6d65c4f9e207.png[/img]

[h1] NEW BLOOD SYSTEM	[/h1]

[list]
    [*]Added new blood stain system.
    
[*]Bloods can be splash walls, floor, characters body and your gun.
    
[*]If you shot your enemies head, head will be explode.
 
[*]After the character dies, blood cover the character.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33637143/0e412c8b2de16b931e38cf59a944513be65df03f.png[/img]

[h1] NEW ANIMATIONS	[/h1]

[list]
    [*] Every weapon animation are fixed.

[*] AK47, SPAS and MP7's animations are changed.

[*] Character running and walking animations are changed.
    
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33637143/91267b908f9429f1d81b2f83d3024d9fc4617e29.png[/img]

[h1] GAMEPLAY UPGRADES AND BUG FIXES	[/h1]

[list]
 [*] You can hear your enemies and allies footstep sounds now.    

[*] Character mechanics are changed.

[*] Movement bobs are changed.

[*] If you press G, your character throw a bomb automaticly.

[*] Weapon recoils are fixed and changed.

[*] Kill notification sound and texts are changed.

[*] If press V for use knife, after than knife won't close [FIXED]

[*] Some English translation issues on User Interface [FIXED] 

[*] Footstep sound bug [FIXED]

[*] Inverted mouse and mouse smooth bugs [FIXED]   
[/list]


[h1] NEXT UPDATE - DOMINATION MAP AND GAME MODE	[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33637143/ac639e298e4b20005f461f0605d0dd4fe10a77b7.png[/img]

notes.title: EXCHANGE BEFORE THE RELEASE UPDATE
notes.content:
[h1] EXCHANGE Before The Release Update Version 0.2.4	[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33637143/11bf9eea0c296baac74ad9471edff170b31f3c01.gif[/img]

[h1] WEAPON MODELS AND SKINS	[/h1]

[list]
    [*]Weapon models are changed;
AK-12 , M416 , MP5-A3, P90 and SPAS12.
    
[*]Added 12 different weapon skin.
    
[*]Added MP7 and SCAR-L.
 
[*]Added new attachments on MP7 and P90.
[/list]

[h1] GAMEPLAY AND INTERFACE	[/h1]

[list]
    [*] Weapon recoils are changed.

[*] You can see both server rooms in server list now, and in room create interface you can select which server do you want to open room.

[*] Some lighting issues fixed.

[*] Added VSYNC on/off button in option menu.
    
[/list]
